title: EkLine
lede: EkLine checks what AI assistants say about a developer tool and whether they can build with it, then opens pull requests to fix the docs and pages behind the wrong answers.

points: Agents audit the website, docs, GitHub repos and community threads for things AI misreads or cannot implement.
It asks AI the questions buyers ask and lists every source behind each answer, including pages the company does not control.
Gaps are ranked, and fixes are drafted from the codebase, Jira and Notion as pull requests that the team approves.
It then reruns the same questions to measure the change; the team cites Socure moving from an agent experience score of 80 to about 95.
A user at Okteto says its agents notice code changes and propose matching documentation updates.

sections.text: API-first companies and developer tool makers whose buyers choose tools by asking ChatGPT and then build with them in Cursor.
The launch comment offers $50 in credits to Product Hunt sign-ups who use a work email. No other pricing is given.
